description: Every host this daemon knows. Each vibed calls itself `local`, with the link `local` and the `vibed` it runs; Linux hosts added to it follow, and their links are `connected` or `down`. `missing` lists what a Linux host lacks of `git`, `gh` and `claude`. `external` says which host is the external address (#18), and `mcp` whether a host serves MCP now (this session's vibed doesn't). Examples from here on are one session, in file order, on a Mac whose home is /Users/me.
